integrity: The proof gives a twelve-sector elementary formula for a generic normal and a continuous extension to exceptional normals. Sampling and numerical integration are corroboration only, not proofs of all-direction or asymptotic claims.
scientific_limitations: Applies to the intersection of three congruent concurrent mutually perpendicular circular cylinders, central intrinsic plane-section areas, and the cubic angular jet at the coordinate normals. Does not determine the global largest section, affine off-center section profile or arbitrary cylinder angles. Two earlier relevant works could not be read in full, leaving priority provisional.
title: Exact twelve-sector sections and cubic directional anisotropy of the Steinmetz tricylinder
